translations: Indeed, I [I] have turned my face
to the One Who created the heavens
and the earth (as) a true monotheist
puzzle.hint: Prophet Ibrahim's (Abraham's) declaration of pure monotheism — a famous statement recited by Muslims worldwide about turning sincerely to Allah alone.
puzzle.arabic: إِنِّى وَجَّهْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّذِى فَطَرَ ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ حَنِيفًۭا ۖ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
puzzle.verseEn: Indeed, I have turned my face [i.e., self] toward He who created the heavens and the earth, inclining toward truth, and I am not of those who associate others with Allāh."
